entries.zh: 仪表、仪容整洁（compostura：修饰、端整之貌）
entries.en: compostura: neatness of appearance, composure of dress and bearing

entries.zh: 仪容、仪态（单字，承上条 compostura 之义）
俊美、仪表堂堂（伶：形容人装扮齐整好看）
entries.en: composed and handsome (of a person's appearance)
entries.notes: 西语为复合释义 'Compuesto hermoso y Leng ly'，单字 伶 配漂亮义属推断，降中置信。

entries.en: ling-li: neat and handsome; clever, quick-witted

entries.zh: 冠冕：帽子、礼冠的戴法修饰（sombrero cerrado：闭合式帽）
entries.en: guan-mian: crown/cap, the adjustment of a closed hat &c.

entries.zh: 买、置办（劃）〔官话栏音写污损难辨，释义存疑〕
entries.en: to buy, procure (right-hand column partially smudged, reading uncertain)
entries.notes: R 栏含 T99 污损难辨，仅据 L/M 两栏推断为购买义。

entries.en: to purchase, acquire (zhi, 'to set/place' in buying sense)

entries.zh: 买零星小物（零碎采买）〔字头有'捘/拣'之疑〕
entries.en: to buy small trifles, odds and ends (head-character uncertain)
entries.notes: 汉字栏标注'疑:捘/拣'，依西语释义'买小物'定义，字证存疑降中置信。

entries.zh: 贸〔原件西语栏空缺，释义存疑：贸易、交易〕
entries.en: trade, commerce 〔source Spanish column blank; gloss conjectural〕
entries.notes: L 栏为[空]，仅据汉字'贸'与对音推断贸易义。

entries.zh: 糴：大宗籴买、整批购入（avult.＝avultado，成批的）
entries.en: to buy in bulk, wholesale purchase (di, as of grain: 'avultado' = by the lot)

entries.zh: 备办：置办必需品〔字头有'僃辨/備辦'之疑〕
entries.en: to buy what is necessary, to provision oneself
entries.notes: 汉字栏标注'疑:僃辨/備辦'，取今体'备办'释义。

entries.zh: 买来添购、买来补足（'para q alance'疑为 para que alcance：使之够用）
entries.en: to buy more to add to it, buy so that it suffices
entries.notes: 西语栏缩写残损'paraq alance'，依汉字'买来添'释义为添购补足。

entries.zh: 坐货：承买同伴货物中属于自己的一份（合伙分货）
entries.en: to buy one's share of a partner's goods, take over a portion of the compañero's hacienda
entries.notes: 西语释义长句被截断（'aparta del tras-'），据汉字'坐货'与合伙语境释义。

entries.zh: 主顾：固定客人、老主顾（按份订购之意）
entries.en: master/patron of the purchase: regular customer (chu-ku)

entries.zh: 主客：主与客（买卖双方；东家与客商）
entries.en: host and guest; buyer and seller, principal and customer
entries.notes: 西语栏杂乱（'in, yacu bir siempre balle-'截断），以汉字'主客'为准。

entries.en: to buy jointly, purchase together (by putting in together)
